description: For a surjective list f : ℕ → A with A infinite, increasingly enumerating the first-occurrence indices gives a bijective list of A. The selected indices are exactly all first-occurrence indices, and the least-occurrence code of each retained value is its selected original index.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.dedup_spec.{u} {α : Type u} [Infinite α] (f : ℕ → α) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
  StrictMono (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.dedupIndex f) ∧
    Set.range (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.dedupIndex f) = Lemmatheca.SetTheory.firstIndices f ∧
      Function.Bijective (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.dedup f) ∧
        ∀ (n : ℕ),
          Lemmatheca.SetTheory.firstOccurrence f hf (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.dedup f n) =
            Lemmatheca.SetTheory.dedupIndex f n
